Schnittstelle Value<A>

Typparameter:
A - the contained value type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Supplier<A>
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Either<L,R>, Eval<A>, Maybe<A>, Provider<A>, Result<A>, Trampoline<T>, Value2<A1,A2>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>, Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>, XorValue<L,R>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Box, Either.Left, Either.Right, Eval.Always, Eval.Later, Eval.Now, Maybe.None, Maybe.Some, Pair, Record2, Record3, Record4, Result.Failure, Result.Success, Trampoline.Done, Trampoline.More, Tuple2, Tuple3, Tuple4
public interface Value<A> extends Supplier<A>

Minimal value‑carrier contract for a single value of type A. Implementations expose presence information and provide access to the value.

Nullability/absence policy is implementation‑specific and must be documented clearly: some implementations may guarantee non‑null values, others may allow absence (similar to Optional) or even tolerate null. Callers should adhere to the concrete type’s contract.

    • get

      A get() throws NoSuchElementException

      Returns the contained value if present. Depending on the concrete contract, this method may throw a NoSuchElementException when no value is present.

      Angegeben von:
      get in Schnittstelle Supplier<A>
      Gibt zurück:
      the contained value
      Löst aus:
      NoSuchElementException - if no value is present according to the implementation’s contract
